continuity: Hyuk Mujin is now Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad under Wipeng and accompanied Jin Wikyung to Henan as his escort while inspecting the Henan branch of the Hyuk Family Textile Shop.
Jin Taekyung has returned to Henan in disguise and reunited with Jin Wikyung and Hyuk Mujin at the Jin Family's rented estate.
Cheongpung fled while being taken to Huashan with the Three Plum Blossom Elites and is currently missing.
Jin Mukyung has remained in closed-door training for approximately one year and six months and will not leave before achieving Great Completion.
Jang Taebo handed Hyuk Mujin a completed spear fifteen days earlier, and Jin Wikyung presented it to Taekyung.
plot: After Jin Taekyung left with the Fire King, Hyuk Mujin's life improved dramatically: Wipeng began instructing him, and he became Vice Squad Leader of the newly formed Jin Dragon Squad. Taekyung's sudden return in the disguise of a ragged beggar immediately ended Mujin's peaceful days when Taekyung ordered him to put his head on the ground.

Taekyung arrived at the large estate rented by the Jin Family of Taiyuan and reunited with Mujin and Jin Wikyung. The Jin Dragon Squad guards mistook Taekyung for a beggar, prompting Mujin to order Hocheol to prostrate himself as well. Wikyung then joked that Taekyung might be a member of the Beggars' Sect before admitting that he had recognized his youngest brother.

Wikyung explained that Lee Seowol continues working to restore the Mount Heng Sword Sect, Wolhwa is establishing an entertainment city in northern Shanxi, and Cheongpung fled while being escorted to Huashan with the Three Plum Blossom Elites and is now missing. Jin Mukyung has remained in closed-door training for roughly a year and six months and refuses to leave until he achieves Great Completion, so he did not attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet.

Wikyung presented Taekyung with a long object that Jang Taebo had handed to Hyuk Mujin fifteen days earlier. When Mujin removed the cloth, Taekyung recognized the object as a spear; Jang Taebo had said that he finally understood the hearts of the legendary swordsmiths Gan Jiang and Mo Ye, and the spear emitted a low hum.

Render 대가리 박아 as Put your head on the ground and 존명존명 as Yes, sir! Yes, sir! in this comedic command context.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Level 50 First Rate martial artist from a wealthy Taiyuan textile-merchant family; Captain of the Gatekeepers at the Jin Family of Taiyuan; deputy squad leader of White Tiger Hall’s reconnaissance squad; candidate to become the next Master of the Gatekeeper Pavilion; has accepted Jin Taekyung’s invitation to train alongside Taekyung and Cheongpung in Taekyung’s private training ground; served as acting Deputy Commander of the Jin Dragon Squad during Wipeng’s four-month Northern Gaoyuan campaign and completed his first mission in that assignment
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Level 50 First Rate martial artist from a wealthy Taiyuan textile-merchant family; Captain of the Gatekeepers at the Jin Family of Taiyuan; deputy squad leader of White Tiger Hall’s reconnaissance squad; candidate to become the next Master of the Gatekeeper Pavilion; has accepted Jin Taekyung’s invitation to train alongside Taekyung and Cheongpung in Taekyung’s private training ground; served as acting Deputy Commander of the Jin Dragon Squad during Wipeng’s four-month Northern Gaoyuan campaign and completed his first mission in that assignment; is now the Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad under Wipeng; accompanied Jin Wikyung to Henan as his escort and is inspecting the Henan branch of the Hyuk Family Textile Shop at his father’s request

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Mysterious young man encountered at Honghwa Inn; an exceptionally young Peak master whose Level Jin Taekyung cannot determine through Qi Sense; the grandson and disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, who secretly descended from Huashan to seek out and defeat the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes, beginning with Jin Mukyung; he has no martial title yet, naturally opened his Governor Vessel through enlightenment two years ago, has begun teaching Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin using Mae Jonghak's training method, has now used Sword Energy and the Zaha Divine Technique during his spar with Taekyung, defended Taekyung from Jeok Cheongang with Huashan martial arts, and Prince Shangshan will only accept his autograph after he gains one; he claims Mae Jonghak has permitted him to become Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and follow Taekyung to Anhui.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Mysterious young man encountered at Honghwa Inn; an exceptionally young Peak master whose Level Jin Taekyung cannot determine through Qi Sense; the grandson and disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, who secretly descended from Huashan to seek out and defeat the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes, beginning with Jin Mukyung; he has no martial title yet, naturally opened his Governor Vessel through enlightenment two years ago, has begun teaching Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin using Mae Jonghak's training method, has now used Sword Energy and the Zaha Divine Technique during his spar with Taekyung, defended Taekyung from Jeok Cheongang with Huashan martial arts, and Prince Shangshan will only accept his autograph after he gains one; he claims Mae Jonghak has permitted him to become Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and follow Taekyung to Anhui; after departing with the Three Plum Blossom Elites for Huashan, he fled during the journey and is currently missing.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Former Guild Leader of the Ironcraft Guild and one of the world’s renowned smiths; spent a full jiazi working at the forge before retiring and living anonymously for more than ten years in a village near Jeongyang; after seeing Taekyung’s enormous supply of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, he accepts the commission to forge it into a weapon capable of making the world tremble and waives monetary payment because the opportunity is sufficient; Jeok Cheongang’s Flame Divine Palm destroyed his home, and he asks Taekyung to have it rebuilt.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Former Guild Leader of the Ironcraft Guild and one of the world’s renowned smiths; spent a full jiazi working at the forge before retiring and living anonymously for more than ten years in a village near Jeongyang; after seeing Taekyung’s enormous supply of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, he accepts the commission to forge it into a weapon capable of making the world tremble and waives monetary payment because the opportunity is sufficient; fifteen days before Chapter 243, he handed Hyuk Mujin the resulting spear for delivery to Taekyung; Jeok Cheongang’s Flame Divine Palm destroyed his home, and he asks Taekyung to have it rebuilt.
